name: Rice Machinery Machine Tools SALES, Service
old_description: Rice Machinery specializes in selling new machine tools, CNC controls, custom building, refurbishing and modernizing used machinery for all manufacturing industries including schools and colleges. We stand by our products 100%, and are well known to take great pride in our work and customer satisfaction.
about:
Rice Machinery, Inc. operates from Cranston, Rhode Island, where it was established in 1968 by S. Arnold Rice under the name Reynolds of Baker Street. The business, now owned by Cory McLaughlin, continues a multi-decade tradition of serving the New England region with machine tool sales and service.

The company functions as an authorized distributor for Sharp CNC machine tools and Acu-Rite G2 CNC controls, while also stocking new and used equipment, repair parts, and accessories. Its 4,000-square-foot showroom and 15,000-square-foot main warehouse—supplemented by three additional warehouses across the state—support a parts and rebuilding department, a demo area, and a fleet of three service trucks that handle on-site installations, retrofits, and repairs. Services include CNC retrofits on knee and bed mills (two- or three-axis), control training, powerfeed and DRO installation, and machine rebuilds performed either in-house or at the customer’s facility.

Customers span general manufacturing sectors as well as educational institutions such as schools and colleges throughout New England.

Rice Machinery emphasizes its exclusive New England distributorship for Sharp and Acu-Rite products and a commitment to standing behind every sale with full product support and customer satisfaction.
